name: takeback
description: Ctrl+Z for AI coding agents. Saves a checkpoint of the project before every prompt and after every turn, so `npx takeback` can put files back, including ones changed by shell commands.

interface.longDescription: Saves a checkpoint of your project before every prompt and after every turn, in a separate git store under ~/.takeback. Run `npx takeback` in the project to undo the last turn, including files changed by shell commands. Your own .git is never touched.
defaultPrompt: Go back to how the project was before your last change.
Show me what src/app.ts looked like before the last turn.
What did you change in the last turn?
